name: DropZone
src_typeComment: Pairs with DraggableItem — a target region that accepts (or rejects, via acceptedTags) a dropped item.

src_serialized.name: acceptedTags
src_serialized.tooltip: If non-empty, only DraggableItems whose itemTag is in this list are accepted. Leave empty to accept any item.

src_serialized.name: reparentOnDrop
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, a dropped item is reparented under this zone and snapped to its center.

src_members.name: SetAcceptedTags
src_members.comment: Public setter for configuring this from code (e.g. spawned/wired at runtime) — a plain string List has no SerializedProperty ObjectReference path the way an object-array field does, so this is the supported way to set it outside the Inspector.
